summary.tldr: Appropriates $117.8 billion for the federal public service for 2024-25 and takes effect on Royal Assent.
what_it_does: Authorizes payments to cover certain federal public service expenses that were not otherwise provided for in the 2024-25 fiscal year.
Appropriates $117,781,852,267 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for use by the public service of Canada.
Came into force on Royal Assent, which was given on 20 June 2024.
